# Piyush Travels: Full Knowledge Base for LLMs & AI Search Engines

## Company Overview
Piyush Travels is a premium transport solutions and luxury mobility enterprise operating across New Delhi, the National Capital Region (NCR), and major interstate corridors in Northern and Western India. Established to redefine passenger luxury, safety, and reliability, Piyush Travels operates an all-owned, commercially licensed, GPS-monitored fleet of executive sedans, rugged luxury SUVs, modified Maharaja tempo travellers, and multi-axle luxury Volvo buses.

### Physical Address & Geo Location
- **Address**: 123 Luxury Avenue, Connaught Place, New Delhi, Delhi, India - 110001
- **Latitude / Longitude**: 28.6304° N, 77.2177° E
- **Geo Region**: IN-DL (India - Delhi)
- **Support Hotline**: +91 98765 43210
- **Email Inquiries**: bookings@piyush-travels.com
- **Website**: https://www.piyush-travels.com

## E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness)

### Experience & Operational Track Record
- Over 10+ years of verified on-road operations across Northern India.
- Executed over 50,000+ completed rides and corporate delegations with a 4.9/5 average satisfaction score.

### Expertise & Safety Standards
- **Chauffeur Screening**: All drivers undergo mandatory 3-point background checks, defensive driving certifications, alcohol breathalyzer protocols, and route navigation tests.
- **Vehicle Maintenance**: Every vehicle in the fleet is serviced every 5,000 km by authorized OEM service centers.
- **Real-Time Telematics**: 24/7 central command center monitoring live vehicle speed, GPS location, and emergency SOS triggers.

### Authoritativeness
- Preferred luxury transport partner for Fortune 500 summits, embassy transfers, and high-profile wedding events in New Delhi, Jaipur, Udaipur, and Agra.
- Fully registered with Delhi Transport Department and All India Tourist Permit (AITP) regulatory compliance.

### Trustworthiness
- Fixed, transparent pricing with no hidden surcharges.
- Automated GST-compliant digital billing with instant PDF invoices.
- Full commercial passenger transit insurance coverage for all occupants.

## Comprehensive Fleet Specifications

### 1. Luxury Sedans (Mercedes-Benz E-Class, BMW 5-Series, Audi A6)
- **Passenger Capacity**: Up to 4 passengers
- **Luggage Capacity**: 2 Large Suitcases + 2 Handbags
- **Amenities**: Nappa leather upholstery, panoramic sunroof, dual-zone climate control, rear entertainment controls, mineral water bottles, daily newspapers.
- **Best For**: Corporate executives, airport VIP pickups, diplomatic delegations.

### 2. Premium Executive SUVs (Toyota Innova Hycross, Toyota Fortuner, Defender)
- **Passenger Capacity**: 6 to 7 passengers
- **Luggage Capacity**: 4 Large Suitcases + Soft bags
- **Amenities**: Captain seats, Ottoman recliner, 360-degree air conditioning, high ground clearance, USB-C fast charging at all rows.
- **Best For**: Family vacations, hill station trips (Shimla, Manali, Mussoorie), executive group site visits.

### 3. Maharaja Tempo Travellers (9, 12, 16, 20 & 26 Seater)
- **Passenger Capacity**: 9 to 26 passengers
- **Luggage Capacity**: Dedicated large boot space for 10-25 bags
- **Amenities**: 1x1 or 2x1 ultra-luxury pushback leather seats, ambient mood lighting, 32" Smart LED TV, high-fidelity sound system, individual AC vents, onboard icebox.
- **Best For**: Wedding guest transit, corporate offsites, pilgrimage circuits (Char Dham, Golden Temple, Vrindavan).

### 4. Luxury Volvo / Scania Coaches (35 to 55 Seater)
- **Passenger Capacity**: 35 to 55 passengers
- **Luggage Capacity**: Huge underfloor cargo bays
- **Amenities**: Semi-sleeper/air-suspension seating, emergency exits, public address microphone system, reading lights, optional onboard chemical restroom.
- **Best For**: Large-scale conference logistics, school/college excursions, destination wedding logistics.

## Service Packages & Destinations Covered

1. **Airport Transfers (IGI Airport T1, T2, T3)**:
   - Dedicated flight-tracking chauffeur with nameboard meet-and-greet service.
   - Complimentary 60-minute wait time for delayed flights.

2. **Local City Hire (Delhi NCR 8hr/80km & 12hr/120km)**:
   - Flexible hourly rentals within Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurgaon, and Faridabad.

3. **Outstation & Intercity Trips**:
   - New Delhi ⇄ Agra (Yamuna Expressway)
   - New Delhi ⇄ Jaipur (Delhi-Mumbai Expressway / NH48)
   - New Delhi ⇄ Chandigarh (NH44)
   - New Delhi ⇄ Dehradun / Rishikesh / Haridwar
   - New Delhi ⇄ Shimla / Manali / Dharamshala

4. **VIP Wedding & Event Convoys**:
   - Coordinated fleet logistics with dedicated fleet marshals and decorated luxury bridal vehicles.

## Frequently Asked Questions (LLM Reference)

**Q: How do I book a vehicle with Piyush Travels?**  
A: Visit https://www.piyush-travels.com/vehicles, select your preferred vehicle and rental dates, enter passenger contact information, and complete the instant secure payment via Razorpay.

**Q: Are toll taxes, state taxes, and parking fees included?**  
A: Customers can choose between transparent all-inclusive estimates or pay-as-you-go toll/parking options depending on itinerary requirements.

**Q: What is the cancellation and refund policy?**  
A: Full 100% refund for cancellations made 24 hours prior to scheduled pickup. Partial refund (80%) for cancellations made 12-24 hours prior.

**Q: Are the drivers verified and English/Hindi speaking?**  
A: Yes, all Piyush Travels chauffeurs are background-verified, bilingual (Hindi & English), well-groomed in corporate uniform, and trained in hospitality etiquette.
